mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing fluticasone systemic exposure, though clinical significance is minimal due to fluticasone's high first-pass metabolism and topical/inhaled routes of administration.
action: Monitor for increased corticosteroid side effects if using systemic fluticasone; no action needed for inhaled or topical formulations due to minimal systemic absorption.
